Solara - (9.5) PULSAR

STRING THEORY

"String theory"

[Verse 1]

Level thirty-seven

And Cala appeared

From where — unclear

She had been following since level thirty-one

This was known

Nobody addressed it

Until she stepped forward

And addressed Cygnus directly

[Pre-Chorus]

“I want to marry you”

Cygnus considered this

For approximately one second

And then he danced

(the dance meant: I am not ready for that)

(everyone understood the dance)

(Cala understood the dance)

[Chorus]

String theory

Invisible thread

String theory

She followed anyway

Not ready, said the dance

Not ready, said the wings

But Cala was here

And Cala was saying

I am very useful

[Verse 2]

“I can sing,” said Cala

“Please don’t,” said Cassie

“Just one—”

“Please don’t,” said Aldric

She sang

(it was not good)

(it was very not good)

(the gate shuddered)

(in the wrong way)

[Pre-Chorus 2]

“That’s enough,” said Solara

“I have other talents,” said Cala

“We know,” said Spida

“The guardian—”

“Yes,” said Spida, “the guardian”

“I know them,” said Cala

“All of them?” said Solara

“All of them,” said Cala

“No singing,” said Solara

“No singing,” said Cala

[Chorus]

String theory

A deal is made

String theory

She stays with us

No singing — confirmed

No singing — agreed

The thread that was following us

Just became official

String theory

[Bridge]

Cala stepped to the gate

Said something no one heard

The guardian answered

The gate opened

Just like that

[Final Chorus]

String theory

She is with us now

String theory

Crew of twelve

The thread that followed from thirty-one

Finally has a name here

Cala is staying

String theory

[Outro]

Solara: “Welcome. No singing.”

Cala: “No singing.”

Cygnus: [one small dance, meaning: we will discuss this later]
